feeds.title: A Bird Hunter's Thoughts
feeds.description: A Bird Hunter's Thoughts is all about Bird dogs and bird hunting across the country. Evaluating bird dogs and bird hunting supplies and techniques that work! Follow this blog where a bird hunter expresses his thoughts and experience on Bird dogs and bird hunting.

feeds.title: Living with Birddogs
feeds.description: Follow this blog where Jared Tappero, Mike Spies and Peter Houser share their experience, and information on bird dog training, bird hunting and much more.

feeds.title: Northwoods Bird Dogs
feeds.description: Follow Northwoods Bird Dogs for the latest news on breeding, training and hunting English setters and pointers.

feeds.title: Mouthful of Feathers
feeds.description: We feel the need for fresh voices that articulate the experience as we know it - wild, elusive birds in massive country, imperfect dogs (and people), dirtbag camps, dirty field guns, trucks stuck in the mud, days spent putting miles on the boots with nothing to show for it, and yes, even a little red stuff now and then. We're here to celebrate the 'whys' and delve deep into the soul of bird dog training and hunting.

feeds.title: Tulsa Bird Dog Association
feeds.description: Founded in 1982, the Tulsa Bird Dog Club was led by president Jerry Myers, vice presidents Joe Minardi and Dean Lenard, secretary Buddy Mickle and treasurer Karen Dillon, promoting outdoor education and specializing in upland hunting and conservation. Find articles informing members of upcoming trials, placements, items for sale and the news of the TBDA and it's membership.

feeds.title: Dogsblog.com » Pointer
feeds.description: dogsblog.com exists to serve one purpose and one purpose only; to help UK shelter dogs find a new, permanent home. Launched in 2007, the site finds homes for thousands of dogs in the shelter system and relieves the UK welfare sector of millions of pounds of costs. Browse through our listings of pointer dogs to help you in your hunting escapades.

feeds.title: The Gundog Club
feeds.description: The Gundog Club is to help people train their gundogs through participation in a non-competitive Graded Training Scheme. This site provides information on gundog training, assessments, and equipment.

feeds.title: Hunting Dog Blog
feeds.description: A blog for aspiring bird hunters and bird dog trainers

feeds.title: The Bird Dog Blogger
feeds.description: This blog is a series of stories about my life with bird dogs; living with them, loving them, huntin' over 'em. And also random stuff that I find interesting, funny, helpful, or just ridiculous. My name is Paul. I've loved dogs all of my life.

feeds.title: Riverview Plantation Blog
feeds.description: On Riverview's exclusive quail hunting plantation. Nestled along the banks of the sleepy Flint River in Southern Georgia, Riverview Plantation boasts thousands of acres to hunt abundant game. The hunting ground offers a wide variety of cover including live oak woods, open stands of pine, feed strips, field borders, broomsedge and weed fields. Keep up to date with the latest news and updates from us, hunting tips, quail hunting and more!

feeds.title: The Accidental Bird Dog
feeds.description: I write unique articles about dog sports, host a podcast about bird dog competitions, design logos, draw dog portraits, and offer coaching. I am Terry Ann. I advise bird dog owners on how to succeed in various types of competitions and hunting. When not being a dog mom, I am a graphic designer, pet portrait artist, and adjunct professor.

feeds.title: Hutson Heritage Blog
feeds.description: Hutson Heritage, LLC has a mission to rekindle the upland sporting heritage through a blending of properly introduced upland (pointing) gun dog education and writings of traditional fly-fishing and upland (pointing) dog techniques. Explore our insights in the bird dog lives, hunting, training and more!

feeds.title: Long Hollow Bird Dogs Blog
feeds.description: We produce some of the best American Field Setters and Pointers in the Country! We offer professional Upland Bird Dog Training for all breeds Pointing Dogs, Flushers and Retrievers. Explore our hunting stories, pointer training tips for dog owners, gear reviews and more!
